svg.aria-label: The revision mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Peer reviewer: the comments as a revision roadmap (agent); Script: anchorize the draft (script); Draft writer: a patch, never a full draft (agent); Script: apply the patch to a new file (script); You decide: retry, full re-emission or abort (stop); You acknowledge it, or the patch is narrowed (stop); You confirm a full re-emission (stop); Citation compliance on the revised draft (agent); Revised draft, apply report, revision log (agent) | paper, as built: Session asks: the closing review, the claim check, the incremental checks, the claims not to make, the earlier papers, the result files [5.Q (i)] (stop); Peer reviewer: the comments as a revision roadmap (agent); Script: anchorize the draft (script); Draft writer: a patch per item, never a full draft (agent); Script: apply the patch to a new file (script); You decide: retry, full re-emission or abort (stop); You acknowledge it, or the patch is narrowed (stop); Citation compliance: format, DOI, retractions, and each claim against the passage read in its source's full text, unless you said no at intake [5.Q (i)], new references among them (ruled); The citation style to confirm, when more than half the cited entries follow another style than the Citation Format row (stop); A claim the run cannot support: the check stops at the first claim not held, and the stop is raised once the agent has ended [5.Q (i)] (stop); A reference that cannot be confirmed, only under strict [5.Q (i)] (stop); Draft writer, resumed: the statements the result files do not bear out, as a patch [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Peer reviewer, resumed, round 2: the re-review (agent); Citation compliance, resumed: the cited sentences of the patch, unless you said no at intake [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Script, run by the session: lookup.py cite-keys and check-urls; latexmk compile with the engine of the class [5.Q (i)] (script); Draft writer, resumed: the reference fix for a missing entry, the compile fix for a failed compile or a box over 10pt [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Draft writer, resumed: response-letter.md beside the manuscript, when the comments are referee comments [5.Q item 5] (ruled, only when needed); Peer reviewer, resumed: response-letter-check.md, a verdict per point [5.Q item 5] (ruled, only when needed); /writing review, unless you said no at intake [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Draft writer: the findings you pick, or the autonomous pass, as a patch [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Revised draft, apply reports, revision log, the rest as limitations (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).

svg.text: academic-paper: no compile and no formatter in this mode, and no intake agent. A tag such as "[5.Q (i)]" names the part of item 3 (i) of step 5.Q's brief that the goal of plan 5 keeps, "[5.Q item 5]" the response letter and its check, and "[5.Q item 6]" the number of sources.
